verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own docs label it "Open Source," and a community user calls it an "open-source library," so readable public source is supported. However, the pack never names the license or its terms, so the "under an open license" part is only claimed, not documented. Missing for 10: the specific license (e.g., an OSI-approved license name and file), documentation of the license terms, and independent confirmation of licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Open Source: No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Crawl4AI is an amazing open-source library that solves many LLM-scraping headaches.
